hero.description: Timeless apparel celebrating India’s legendary textile art. Crafted from pure handwoven flax linen, organic khadi, and natural botanical dyes for conscious elegance.

sustainability.heading: Conscious Textiles, Sacred Tradition
sustainability.intro: Every thread honors generations of Indian master weavers, rainfed organic crops, and ancient natural vat dyeing.

pillars.title: Rainfed Indian Flax
pillars.text: Cultivated in harmony with monsoon rains, our organic flax requires zero heavy chemical fertilizers or depleting groundwater pumps.

pillars.title: Desi Botanical Dyes
pillars.text: Colored naturally using wild Indian indigo, turmeric, harda, and upcycled temple marigold flowers completely free from synthetic azo chemicals.

pillars.title: Artisan Weaver Co-Ops
pillars.text: Supporting rural Indian handloom clusters with fair wages, safe loom environments, and heritage preservation initiatives.

about.heading: Celebrating Indian Craftsmanship
about.body: Founded with a vision to re-imagine traditional Indian textiles for the contemporary wardrobe, **reface CLOTHING** fuses relaxed modern silhouettes with ancient handloom artistry. We celebrate the organic slub, breathability, and natural texture of pure Indian linen and hand-spun khadi.

video_showcase.heading: Craft in Motion
video_showcase.intro: Explore handloom weaving, indigo botanical dyeing, and signature linen drapes in action.
